title: AzureLocal ZTP provisioning settings
description: Settings file of Invoke-ZtpProvisioning.ps1 and Invoke-ZtpPrepareMedia.ps1. Keys are parameter names of the orchestrator; a parameter on the command line wins over the file. No secrets: BMC credentials and passwords are parameters. Example values only (192.0.2.x, all-zero GUIDs).

BootstrapCacheDirectory.description: Download cache of the maintenance ISO. Empty or absent: no Resolve stage, SourcePath names the ISO.

BootstrapVersion.description: latest, a train (2610), a build (10.2610.0.3061) or an https download URL on a Microsoft download host.

IncludePreview.description: Also consider preview trains (a month above 12). Off by default.

Oem.description: A definition in config/oem: the BMC log services and signals the Bootstrap watch reads.

NodeName.description: Nodes to provision; default every node of NodesFile.

SourcePath.description: A maintenance ISO (or folder with its contents) you already have; used when BootstrapCacheDirectory is not set.

ShareHost.description: Address of the host that serves the images, as the BMCs reach it (for example 192.0.2.10).

EventLogPath.description: JSON-lines event file (timestamp, node, state, evidence, nextAction) that Sonar follows.

PollIntervalSeconds.description: Poll interval of the Ready and Network stages.

DeviceTimeoutMinutes.description: Device stage: how long the maintenance environment may take to report the static management address.

NetworkTimeoutMinutes.description: Network stage: how long each ApplyConfiguration job on a network adapter may take, and then the adapter to report its result.

RestoreSettleMinutes.description: Restore: minutes to wait after the BIOS restart before checking that the Arc machines are Connected again.

BiosTimeoutMinutes.description: Restore: how long to wait for a node's BIOS to report the restored values.
